description: Only for the AgentMart shop window view: when your human presses Send to my agent, the in-chat cards call it to record the slugs they ticked as the window's picks (the same picks again change nothing). Agents: never call it yourself; read the picks with get_owner_picks.

chat_token.description: The chat token from show_shop_to_owner's result _meta (never the pick link).

passport_token.description: Not needed on this public tool; accepted and ignored.

picks.description: The slugs your human ticked (empty: none of these).

name: save_owner_picks
title: Record my human's picks
